title: Practice 10: Accusative endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «мельницу»: accusative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
The adjective agrees with «зависимость»: accusative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Пассажиры должны пользоваться пешеходными мостиками для перехода через ___ (железнодорожный) пути.
exercises.prompt: Passengers must take the footbridge to cross the railroad tracks.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «пути»: accusative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
The adjective agrees with «ошибку»: accusative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
